name: Pruella Nash
source_profile:
Pruella Nash (CN) — Printer and Proprietor of the Blackvein Clarion

Pruella is an ambitious printer and pamphleteer who publishes the Blackvein Clarion, a weekly broadsheet devoted to mining discoveries, claim transfers, commercial advertisements, political commentary, and sensational accounts of frontier crime.

Her publication is widely read among prospectors and merchants, and its reports of newly discovered mineral deposits have occasionally caused speculative frenzies before the claims in question could be properly verified. Pruella considers this enthusiasm a natural consequence of frontier enterprise and rarely apologizes for stories that prove exaggerated.

Although she frequently criticizes the marquis's administration, Pruella also recognizes that the prosperity of Blackvein depends upon public confidence in its mining industry. Her relationships with Gable Sorn and other influential merchants are consequently uneasy: she depends upon their advertisements while remaining eager to publish stories exposing their misconduct.

Sheriff Lorne has repeatedly complained that Pruella's reporting complicates criminal investigations, particularly when the Clarion publishes details that were intended to remain confidential. Pruella insists that the people of Blackvein possess a right to know what occurs in their town, whether the authorities approve or not.
